6528-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Elfsworn Giant triggers, creating a 1/1 green Elf Warrior creature token
Resolve Scarland Thrinax's ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

654-2577-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
654-2577-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

3591-3629-8089.easyPrerequisites: Cloudsteel Kirin attached to a creature you control.
3591-3629-8089.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying life.
Repeat step 1 until you have 0 life.
Cast Mister Negative by paying {5}{W}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Mister Negative enters, it triggers, swapping your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 life.

1379-5256-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
1379-5256-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter as an artifact land creature due to Encroaching Mycosynth and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 2 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Altar of Dementia.

301-2486-7859.description:
Activate Goblin Chirurgeon by sacrificing Putrid Goblin.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve the Goblin Chirurgeon ability.
Repeat.

4131-4574-4659-5283-6842.notablePrerequisites: There must be at least one +1/+1 counter each on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts.
4131-4574-4659-5283-6842.description:
Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Inexorable Tide triggers, putting one +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer and at least two additional artifacts you control.
Activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Basalt Monolith from your graveyard on top of your library.
Activate Iron Spider's last ability by paying {2} and removing two +1/+1 counters from artifacts you control, drawing Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3921-6627.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

requires.n: Instant or Sorcery that Targets a Creature and Creates Treasure
Creature that Returns an Instant or Sorcery from Graveyard to Hand on Entering

4615-7845--178--179.description:
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost targeting the creature that can recur spells.
When you cast that spell, Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Quasiduplicate and choosing Spinerock Tyrant as its target.
Resolve the copy of Quasiduplicate, creating a Spinerock Tyrant token.
Resolve the original Quasiduplicate, creating a token copy of the spell recursion creature.
When that token enters, it triggers, returning Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 1 one additional time, resulting in a total of five Spinerock Tyrants.
Cast the spell that creates a Treasure token by paying its mana cost, targeting any creature.
Each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying that spell once for each Spinerock Tyrant you control.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating at least one Treasure token each time.
Activate those Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding one mana per Treasure.
Cast Quasiduplicate by paying its mana cost targeting the spell recursion creature.
When you cast that spell, each copy of Spinerock Tyrant triggers, copying Quasiduplicate once for each Spinerock Tyrant and choosing the spell recursion creature once and Spinerock Tyrant as each additional spell's target.
Resolve all copies of that spell, creating two copies of the spell recursion creature and additional copies of Spinerock Tyrant.
When the first spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning the spell that creates Treasure from your graveyard to your hand.
 When the second spell recursion creature token enters, it triggers, returning Quasiduplicate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 7.
4615-7845--178--179.notes: The mana needed is calculated assuming you use a spell that costs 2 to cast and creates one Treasure token.

2034-4929-5224-7646.description:
Cast Cryptic Trilobite by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Cryptic Trilobite.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cryptic Trilobite, adding {C}{C}.
When Cryptic Trilobite dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Cryptic Trilobite from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

654-1575-4231-7313.description:
Activate a Food by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color due to Ninja Pizza.
Nuka-Cola Vending Machine triggers, creating a tapped Food, Clue and Treasure token due to Academy Manufactor.
When the tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers three times, untapping them.
Repeat.
654-1575-4231-7313.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Food to its native ability to gain life.

1020-1594-2034-2866.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Helm of Awakening.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Helm of Awakening.
Repeat.

2604-3532-5078-5240.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Oneirophage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

380-2773-3362.description:
Cast Bladewing by paying {3}{B}{B}{R}{R}.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it, Warstorm Surge and Miirym trigger.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning any Dragon from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge, dealing 4 damage to Bladewing.
Bladewing dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Resolve the Miirym trigger, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Bladewing.
When the Bladewing token enters the battlefield, it and Warstorm Surge trigger.
Resolve the Warstorm Surge trigger, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing token's trigger, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2466-5051-5078-6918.description:
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Honor-Worn Shaku's second ability by tapping Traxos, untapping Honor-Worn Shaku.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

751-1741-6751.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{U}.

Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Holding priority, activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Resolve the second Cloud of Faeries trigger, untapping up to two lands.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning it and Cloud of Faeries from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

527-542-1879.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-1879.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

224-1174-3177.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
You control a mana-producing land.

When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout.
Activate the land and another land by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, untapping another land.
Repeat.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

1170-4872-6333.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
You have enough mana to cast Time Warp each turn.

Cast Time Warp from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Hades and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Emet-Selch.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
Resolve Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

When Uruk-hai Berserker dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Uruk-hai Berserker that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Uruk-hai Berserker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Uruk-hai Berserker token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

Activate Kenrith by paying {G}, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {G}.

You may place additional counters on Crystalline Crawler to get infinite mana, and then use that mana to activate Kenrith's abilities.
Once you have infinite mana, you may spend it on Kenrith's other abilities.

501-586-5256-5258-5618.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to Priest of Gix's power.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

When the Felidar Guardian tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, blinking the mana-producing permanent and The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.

2523-5231-5559.description:

Nazgûl enters, triggering its first activated ability, causing the Ring to tempt you; choose Nazgûl as your Ring-bearer, making it legendary.
Nazgûl's second activated ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each Wraith you control.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Nazgûl, adding {R}.
Ratadrabik of Urborg triggers, creating a token copy of Nazgûl that's a 2/2 Zombie.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Dragon Egg, adding {C}{C}.
When the Dragon Egg dies, it triggers, creating a 2/2 Dragon creature token.
Repeat.

Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning Ornithopter to your hand from the battlefield, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token with flying.
Repeat.

Activate the Bloom Tender token by tapping it, adding at least {2}{R}{G}.

Dockside Extortionist dies, triggering Decaying Soil, causing you to pay {1} to return Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.

Activate Patchwork Crawler using Zaxara's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Patchwork Crawler using Horseshoe Crab's ability by paying {U}, untapping Patchwork Crawler.

Kaya's loyalty abilities have not been used this turn.
Any creature exiled by Semblance Anvil.

Activate Kaya's +1 loyalty ability to put a Ghostform Counter on Felidar Guardian.
Sacrifice Felidar Guardian to Phyrexian Altar for {W}.
Felidar Guardian is returned to your hand, and you create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.

Freed from the Real attached to Voyaging Satyr.

Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Karmic Guide with haste.
When the Karmic Guide token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
